narrative.overview:
Firefly's world is a dark, quiet room with one signal in it. Night runs edge to edge; strangers are faint Wing-light dots; the only bright thing on a screen is Glow, and it belongs to the pod. Over it sits a civic, almost municipal grotesk layer: very large, tight Host Grotesk in white, small two-line labels, hairline rules and solid block cells. Nothing is decorated. Hierarchy comes from size and from the muted-over-white pairing, not from weight, colour or containers.

The world was established by the landing page (`src/features/landing/`, built 2026-11-25). That page is always Night regardless of the visitor's light/dark setting, a confirmed exception. App screens are not built yet; they will follow the system light/dark setting, and the light variant of the brand (Night on Paper, Wing-light wings) exists in `brand/` but has no built screens, so this file records no light-mode tokens. The root stylesheet's light defaults (Wing text on white) are placeholders, not a designed light system.

Motion is one idea: repetition made visible. The scroll-driven field shows a crowd blinking at random while five dots gather, light up and fall into step (Kuramoto synchrony). Everything else is near-still. There is no photography; people are represented by initials and the example pod is labelled as made up.
keyCharacteristics: Night ground edge to edge; one Glow per composition.
Host Grotesk only, regular weight for display, tight negative tracking; size carries hierarchy.
Two-line labels: muted context line over the white fact.
Hairline rules and square block cells instead of cards, shadows or gradients.
Flat dots: a flash is size and opacity, never blur or bloom.
Phone first from 360px; everything readable with the motion switched off.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Each composition has exactly one Glow element. On the story stage it is the pod; in the pod preview it is the chat dot; in the invite section it is the submit block. If a second Glow appears on screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No Glow on Paper Rule
rules.body: Glow never carries text or an essential indicator on a light surface; on light, the glow becomes Night (brand/README.md).

rules.name: The Solid Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow over Night is drawn at full opacity; dimmed Glow turns olive. Lit pod dots flash by swelling, not fading.

rules.name: The Size Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by size and by the muted/white pairing. Display and headline stay at 400; nothing on the page is bold.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.02em at title, -0.03em at statement, -0.035em at headline, -0.04em at display.

rules.name: The Flat Dot Rule
rules.body: The flat dot is the light. Field dots, the chat dot, separators and the mark are solid circles; a flash is shown by size and opacity, never by blur, bloom or glow.

dos: Do keep one Glow element per composition, at full opacity.
Do set display type in Host Grotesk 400 with negative tracking (-0.04em at display).
Do pair a Muted context line over an Ink fact for labels.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines at Wing Light 18%.
Do keep header cells, buttons and inputs square (0 radius).
Do give every motion a still, end-state version under reduced motion, and pause canvas loops when off-screen or the tab is hidden.
Do use initials and clearly labelled made-up examples until consenting photography exists.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, blur, bloom or glows to dots, the mark or surfaces.
Don't use bold weights for hierarchy; use size.
Don't wrap content in cards; the phone preview is the one framed object.
Don't put Glow text or essential Glow indicators on a light surface.
Don't load fonts from a CDN; Host Grotesk is self-hosted.
Don't invent light-mode tokens from the landing page; the light system is unbuilt.
